methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true;let each=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&flexing(c))flexN=flexN+1;if(flexN>0){let content=0;let visN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;visN=visN+1;if(!flexing(c))content=content+c.footprint()[size]}const extent=this.contentExtent(size);each=Math.max(0,(extent-content-this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1))/flexN)}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";let line=0;let lineBase=0;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;line=Math.max(line,c.footprint()[crossSize]);const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize))}let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=each;if(al!="none"){const fc=f==null?c.footprint():f;const leadC=axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-fc[crossSize])/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-fc[crossSize];else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC)}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?each:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})

f=t.from??0;if(W>=f&&(tier==null||f>(tier.from??0)))tier=t}if(tier==null)for(const t of plans){if(tier==null||(t.from??0)<(tier.from??0))tier=t}if(tier==null)tier={flow:"row"};const stack=tier.flow=="stack";const gap=typeof tier.gap=="number"?tier.gap:this.gap;const share=tier.share!=null&&typeof tier.share=="object"?tier.share:{};const where=" (the plan from "+(tier.from??0)+", on "+view.constructor.name+")";const al=tier.align!=null?tier.align:this.align;if(al!="start"&&al!="center"&&al!="end"&&al!="baseline"){throw new Error("align is "+JSON.stringify(al)+where+' \u2014 a ResponsiveLayout places both axes of its children, so it always says where they sit across the flow: "start", "center", "end" or "baseline"')}const shares=new Map;let total=0;for(const name of Object.keys(share)){const c=view[name];if(c==null||kids.indexOf(c)<0){throw new Error("the plan names '"+name+"', but "+view.constructor.name+" has no laid child named '"+name+"'")}const v=share[name];if(v==="auto")continue;if(typeof v!="number"||!isFinite(v)||v<0||v>100){throw new Error("the share for '"+name+"' is "+JSON.stringify(v)+where+' \u2014 a share is a number from 0 to 100 (and 0 drops the child), or the word "auto" to keep the child at its natural size')}shares.set(c,v);total=total+v}if(!stack&&total>100+1e-6){throw new Error("the row's shares add up to "+Math.round(total*100)/100+"%"+where+' \u2014 the shares of a row divide one run and cannot claim more than 100% of it; a child that should keep its natural size is named "auto" or left out of the share')}const offsets=new Map;const offset=tier.offset!=null&&typeof tier.offset=="object"?tier.offset:{};for(const name of Object.keys(offset)){const c=view[name];if(c==null||kids.indexOf(c)<0){throw new Error("the plan's offset names '"+name+"', but "+view.constructor.name+" has no laid child named '"+name+"'")}const v=offset[name];if(typeof v!="number"||!isFinite(v)){throw new Error("the offset for '"+name+"' is "+JSON.stringify(v)+where+" \u2014 an offset is a number of pixels across the flow, from where align places the child")}offsets.set(c,v)}const hidden=c=>shares.get(c)===0;const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true&&!hidden(c);let visN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&!hidden(c))visN=visN+1;const avail=W-gap*Math.max(0,visN-1);let naturalRun=0;if(!stack){for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible||hidden(c)||flexing(c)||shares.has(c))continue;naturalRun=naturalRun+c.footprint().width}}const base=Math.max(0,avail-naturalRun);const shareW=c=>(stack?W:base)*shares.get(c)/100;let rigid=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible||hidden(c))continue;if(flexing(c)){flexN=flexN+1;continue}rigid=rigid+(stack?c.footprint().height:shares.has(c)?shareW(c):c.footprint().width)}const room=stack?this.contentExtent("height")-gap*Math.max(0,visN-1):avail;const each=flexN>0?Math.max(0,room-rigid)/flexN:0;const cross=stack?"x":"y";const crossSize=stack?"width":"height";const allocated=c=>flexing(c)||shares.has(c);const crossExt=c=>!allocated(c)?c.footprint()[crossSize]:stack?shares.has(c)?shareW(c):c.width:c.height;const crossLead=c=>allocated(c)?0:stack?c.footprint().x:c.footprint().y;if(al=="baseline"&&stack)this.refuseStackBaseline();const onBaseline=al=="baseline"&&!stack;let line=0;let lineBase=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible||hidden(c))continue;line=Math.max(line,crossExt(c));const b=c.baseline;if(onBaseline&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize));const across=c=>{let o=0;if(al=="center")o=(line-crossExt(c))/2;else if(al=="end")o=line-crossExt(c);else if(onBaseline){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")o=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}return o-(onBaseline?0:crossLead(c))+(offsets.has(c)?offsets.get(c):0)};let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{if(hidden(c)){return stack?{x:0,y:pos,vis:false}:{x:pos,y:0,vis:false}}const natural=!flexing(c)&&!(stack?false:shares.has(c));const f=natural?c.footprint():null;const lead=f==null?0:stack?f.y:f.x;const box=stack?{y:pos-lead}:{x:pos-lead};box[cross]=across(c);if(shares.has(c))box.w=shareW(c);if(flexing(c))box[stack?"h":"w"]=each;const adv=flexing(c)?each:stack?f.height:shares.has(c)?shareW(c):f.width;if(c.visible)pos=pos+adv+gap;return box})

value.value: Declare it. It runs. It stays true.
A binding isn’t a callback you remember to re-run — it’s a standing relationship the runtime keeps true, re-derived the moment its inputs change.
Three bindings track one value: the big number, the bar’s width, and its color. Click to bump v — all three update together, and the color crosses cool to warm at the halfway mark.
Declare the shape, not the loop.
A view can be built from data instead of laid out by hand — the shape written once, the data deciding how many there are and what each one says.
One Bar, instanced once per row of the data. Edit a number or add a row and the list rebuilds itself — no loop, no keys. And Bar is auto-included: no import, no definition, just use it.
You say where a thing belongs; a Spring finds the path there and settles by physics — motion you declare, not a timeline you sequence.
Click to toggle the ball’s target between two positions. The Spring follows and settles by physics — no timeline, no frames driven by hand.
Your AI can write the code. Can it tell when it’s wrong?
In Declare, yes. A small language gets it started; these four tools let it catch its mistakes, fix them, and finish.
